patterns: Most frequent shape: 'which is NOT a warm/cold current' or 'which does not flow in the North Atlantic/Pacific' (Humboldt, Benguela, Agulhas, Canaries).
APPSC asks direct one-liners: wavelength definition, tide timing (next-day high tide), Humboldt not warm, ITEWS bottom pressure recorders.
Sargasso Sea (no coastline, North Atlantic, seaweed) and fishing grounds where warm and cold currents meet recur across PSCs.
Tide items: spring vs neap, tidal ports, Gulf of Khambhat tidal energy, Chandipur receding sea.
App MCQs add ENSO mechanics, INCOIS services and 2026 current-affairs angles beyond what PYQs show; still largely sound.
